title: A Noble Suspicion
text: “There are also reports of people whose lifespans shortened due to differing beastification manifesting in their bodies because of lineage and constitution.”
“Ah, like a wolf and a snake coming out at the same time and turning into some kind of chimera?”
“Yes. It’s exceedingly rare, but in such cases, it becomes a disease known as hereditary hybrid beastification. As for treatment, one must consciously work to suppress one of the two beast forms.”
“The fact that such a disease exists really does feel like something out of another world…”
“Well, it can be a weakness, but the strength of this condition is that it can also be turned into a strength.”
“Ah, so depending on the situation, sometimes a wolf, sometimes a snake?”
The Siltvelt envoy nodded at Father’s reply.

“Yes. If properly controlled, one becomes an exceptional individual capable of multiple beast transformations. There are accounts of some using cooperative magic with companions as a trigger to master it, and even anecdotes of mastering it with a Hero’s help.”
That reminded me of how Rival kept changing shape one after another. Come to think of it, it had been controlling its transformations by chanting magic together with Assistant and Mole, indeed.

“Rather than just looking at the negative side, we should look for the positive too—if we can properly improve the symptoms through Class Ups and Level Ups, there’s even the possibility of a full cure.”
“Yes.”
“And beyond that, couldn’t medicine, or alchemy research, or something like that cure it too?”
“I don’t think it’s impossible, I say.”

At my reply, Father looked over at me. Staring at me that intently is going to make me blush, indeed. But it is the truth, I say. This Motoyasu, if Filolial-sama wished to fly through the sky, would grant Filolial-sama the ability to fly so long as Fleon-chan were present, indeed. So naturally, modifying a body is well within my wheelhouse.
“Eh? You can do that, Motoyasu-kun?”
“I can, indeed. Body modification. It’s among the skills I’ve acquired over the course of the loops, I say.”

Incidentally, Father managed it at some point too. Something about it being unlocked through a cursed weapon, apparently, but in my case, it seems to be more like the official version, acquired through a separate route. By having my spear memorize materials and weapons from all across the world, I have thoroughly mastered the alchemy-type skills, indeed. Filo-tan told me not to use cursed weapons, so this Motoyasu keeps that promise faithfully, I say.
“Shall I modify your body for you? If you like, I could turn you into a squirrel instead of a rabbit, indeed.”

This rabbit man, with his knack for splitting hairs and swiftly using the mongrel lizardman as a shield, reminds me of Itsuki using Ren as a shield, so somehow a squirrel feels fitting, I say. After all, Itsuki turns into a riska. More than anything, the way he lectured Itsuki about justice suggests they’re birds of a feather. Perhaps the reason Father chose the rabbit man back then was because he felt he’d been set up by Itsuki—maybe the impressions overlapped in his mind, indeed.

You might think, well then what about you? But analyzing that situation I secretly observed, there was no slave whose impression overlapped with mine, which is why he ended up choosing Big Sister, I say. No… though perhaps this rabbit man barely qualifies as a match for me even now, indeed. Looking closely at the rabbit man’s face again, it’s actually quite well put together. If he took better care of his appearance, he wouldn’t look bad at all. He’s got the makings of a fine-looking man, indeed. Ah, that’s it—he’s got the kind of face that wouldn’t look out of place among the handsome men some pig possessed by a certain princess-pig once envisioned in her fantasies, indeed. The classic setup where he’s secretly a person of noble birth who’s fallen to the status of a slave.

…It’s entirely possible, I say. Judging from how protective Older Sister is of Big Sister, my intuition tells me there might be something to Big Sister too, indeed. Unfortunately, I’ve barely heard anything to that effect. Older Sister keeps her mouth so tightly shut that all I really know is a vague sense that Big Sister’s parents came from a modestly wealthy family, perhaps.

Returning to my thoughts, it wouldn’t be strange at all for that decently-faced rabbit man to overlap with me. Being someone who possesses a transformation spell that lets me become a usaunny myself, I simply cannot overlook a rabbit, indeed. Rabbits are adorable, I say. I’d love for Father to pet me. So perhaps there was some other reason Father chose Big Sister back then, indeed.
“Hi—!? N-no, that’s quite alright. You don’t need to go to such lengths for my sake! I’ll just go for a bit of a run.”
The rabbit man swiftly used the mongrel lizardman and Father as shields and made his escape from the spot, indeed.
“Why are you threatening Theo?”
“I am not threatening him, indeed. I merely thought a squirrel would suit him better than a rabbit, so I proposed it, I say.”
“Are you trying to say something about the rodent connection? I really don’t think Theo wants that kind of modification…”
“I do think it’s a bit much to go around scaring him like that…”
The mongrel lizardman sighed and agreed with Father’s opinion.

“Well, his arm did beastify from a seizure earlier, but the frequency has dropped quite a bit, so I think it’s fine to keep watching for now. If problems come up after a Level Up or Class Up, that’s when we can ask for help, that sort of thing.”
“…That’s true.”

The mongrel lizardman agreed there for some reason, indeed. As I’d later learn, the mongrel lizardman had a complex about being unable to beastify himself, and had apparently been watching the rabbit man’s unwanted transformation symptoms with rather mixed feelings, I say.
“If anything, I’m starting to think it’d be harder to find something Spear Hero-sama can’t do.”
“Ahaha… well, that’s Motoyasu-kun for you.”
“Apparently even he can’t manage against that drunk woman, though,” the mongrel lizardman muttered.
Indeed, Older Sister is a tough opponent to handle. So is Panda, I say. Come to think of it, I’d forgotten to invite Panda again. I should consult Father about it.
“That’s right, Father.”
“Hm? What is it?”
“Actually—”
“Elmelo-san’s war buddy is here?”
“It’s a tavern I frequent whenever I come to this country.”
“Ooh, I wonder if they have good drinks here.”

We had come to a tavern in Siltvelt, indeed. Myself, Elephant, Father, and Older Sister had come once again to recruit Panda. The Siltvelt envoy had gone off to make a report since we’d arrived. Well, they do regularly bring slaves down here anyway, apparently. And it seems they’re also arranging Class Up matters in advance while at it. According to Father, he intends to deliberately keep everyone’s Level at 40 or below during the waves. Apparently that’s to avoid arousing suspicion, I say. But enough of that—back to recruiting Panda. I hadn’t managed to persuade Panda well on my own, but with Father and Older Sister here, it will surely work. And to be doubly sure, with Elephant’s backing on top of that, we will absolutely be able to bring Panda along, indeed. There is no doubt Father intends to hire her for the circus as a crowd-drawing panda. Once inside the tavern, we casually ordered drinks and waited, indeed. Ah, and Elephant, being an acquaintance here, went off to greet the tavern master and the like.
“I wonder what kind of drinks they have here.”
“Sadeena-san, have you never been to Siltvelt?”
“I’ve stopped by before, but only passed through, really.”
As we chatted about such things, the drinks arrived, indeed. Older Sister downed hers in one magnificent gulp.
“Oh my, seems like they’ve got some pretty good drinks here.”
“We’re meeting someone Motoyasu-kun wants to introduce, so take it easy, alright?”
“I know, I know. Besides, Big Sis was actually hoping to have a private chat with Naofumi-chan and the others too.”
“Something on your mind?”
“Well, specifically it’d be about Raphtalia-chan and the others, I suppose.”

Older Sister confided in us, looking a touch troubled, indeed. It seemed Older Sister, much like Father, had also been keeping things vague about whether to let Big Sister and the others join the circus. But apparently Big Sister and the others’ enthusiasm had been steadily growing, and they’d been doing quite a bit of research, touring circuses in Zeltoble and elsewhere. And it seemed they’d been using Older Sister as their daily audience to showcase the fruits of their practice and their passion, begging her to persuade Father on their behalf. It seemed even Older Sister had finally been worn down by their enthusiasm and decided to consult with Father and the others, which is how she came to confide in us like this, indeed.
